verdicts.item:
3. A04-2, A04-4: Submitting an admitted implementation activates it, the Activation recorded by
   the kernel; submitting it again changes nothing.
   [witness: verification:kernel_a04_admitted_submission_activates_once]
statements: A04-2: admitted <-> corpus != empty AND for_all case IN corpus: passed(case)

A04-4: submit(impl) AND verdict(impl, current_corpus) = admitted
         AND current_activation != impl  -> new Activation(by kernel)
verdicts.why: The check asserts that this nonempty-corpus submission is admitted, creates a kernel Activation, and that immediate resubmission reuses the verdict and Activation without adding executions or verdicts. It does not assert the A04-2 biconditional in full: it never checks that the trial execution passed, nor that admission is refused for an empty corpus or any failing case.
